title: Web Safe 216
description: Limits all texture colors to the Web Safe 216 format
body:
This pack only uses 216 colors which are titled "Web Safe".
Here is a Wiki page about them: [[Link]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_colors#Web-safe_colors)

Basically this pack is more like one of those 8bit, old school vibe, packs.

Semi-transparency doesn't exist and some blocks share really similar textures.

It is just interesting to use it while flying around and looking at different builds.

Btw, it is so large because it makes even smallest textures into ~1.2kb.
